title: Move My Hero
goal: Use arrow keys to walk a hero around a stage.
mascot_lines: When the player presses an arrow key, we want the hero to move.
We do that by adding a small number to the hero's position every frame.
Add to move right. Take away to move left.
If we do this every single frame, the motion looks smooth instead of jumpy.

tier2.rephrase: Click on the game first, then press the right arrow key.

tier3.nudge: Right arrow → hero goes right. Hold it down to keep going!

payload.prompt: Use arrow keys (or A/D) to walk. Up/W/Space to jump. Reach the green flag!
